item.title: Elijah Stobaugh’s emergence is giving Maryland men’s lacrosse a new weapon
item.description: Stobaugh played sparingly the past two seasons, but ranks second on the Terps in goals through two games.

item.title: Former Washington Post staffers contemplate future of sports journalism at UMD panel
item.description: The Post eliminated its sports section and laid off one-third of its staff earlier this month.

item.title: Lauren LaPointe’s heroics power No. 3 Maryland women’s lacrosse to 17-15 win over Saint Joseph’s
item.description: Led by LaPointe, nine different players scored a goal and five players attempted three or more shots.

item.title: Anchors lead Maryland gymnastics to final-rotation comeback win over Nebraska
item.description: The Terps’ lowest score in their final-rotation comeback was a 9.850. They scored a 49.350, matching their second-best floor score this season.

item.title: Maryland wrestling snaps nine-dual skid in 20-19 win over Drexel
item.description: The Terps earned their first victory since Dec. 5.

item.title: UMD’s Bhangra Club reflects on history, passion as members look for gold in Miami
item.description: The Bhangra Club will compete in the Vice City Showdown in Miami on Saturday.

item.title: Ninth-inning bullpen implosion dooms Maryland baseball in 7-6 loss to Louisiana
item.description: The Terps entered the ninth inning up three. They didn't record an out in the frame.

item.title: Maryland men’s lacrosse suffers first loss to Princeton since 2004, falls 13-12
item.description: In No. 2 Maryland men’s lacrosse’s nine straight wins over No. 12 Princeton, the Terps clamped the Tigers’ offense. They allowed Princeton to score double-digit goals just once, a 15-10 win in 2022, and surrendered an average of seven goals in their last three wins. item.title: Maryland men’s basketball overcomes height mismatch in 64-60 win over Washington
item.description: The Terps limited the Huskies — the Big Ten’s fourth-best offensive rebounding team, according to KenPom — to just two second-chance points.

item.title: Maryland softball splits doubleheader against Toledo, Liberty in Liberty Softball Classic
item.description: The Terps beat Toledo, 4-0, before losing to Liberty, 3-2.
